description: This is a PHPUnit test class for testing the ReportingMethodConfigurationService in the OrangeHRM project. It contains setup routines and multiple test methods that verify the behavior of the service's CRUD operations and data retrieval functionalities related to ReportingMethod entities.

classes.name: ReportingMethodConfigurationServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the ReportingMethodConfigurationService's methods, including get, save, delete, and count operations for ReportingMethod entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, setting up the service instance and loading fixtures.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of ReportingMethod objects using the service.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodById
methods.description: Verifies fetching a ReportingMethod by its ID.

methods.name: testDeleteReportingMethods
methods.description: Checks deleting multiple ReportingMethods and returning the count of deleted items.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodByName
methods.description: Tests retrieving a ReportingMethod by its name.

methods.name: testSaveReportingMethod
methods.description: Verifies saving a new ReportingMethod entity.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodCount
methods.description: Tests counting ReportingMethod entities based on search filters.
